question: To whom must a particular gift be given, given the requirement that the recipient has been tested for one year after prior accomplishment?
premises: A gift is marked as something to be given.
The intended recipient is one previously accomplished.
That recipient is to be one tested for a full year.
inference: Only a previously accomplished person tested for one year qualifies to receive the gift.
uncertainties: The nature of the gift itself is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: What is to be given should go to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
